versions.changelog:
Initial release of migration-planner — a tool for planning legacy system migrations using the Strangler Fig pattern.

- Analyzes legacy source code to produce evidence-based migration plans and per-domain SPECs.
- Targets .NET (Blazor WebAssembly, .NET MAUI, ASP.NET Core) by default, but allows user to choose any stack.
- All user-facing questions/confirmations are in Portuguese (pt-BR); technical output is in English.
- Strict trust and safety guardrails: read-only until user approval, no code implementation, and careful handling of secrets.
- Comprehensive workflow covering research, planning, and gated delivery of SPECs and Issues.
